content:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`** (imported from `@/connect`).

That module is the frontend home for the memo CRUD mutations and queries — the React Query hooks `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, `useMemoQuery`/`useInfiniteMemoList`, comment listing, etc. Every one of them delegates to the generated Connect service client `memoServiceClient` (imported at `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:5` from `@/connect`), calling `createMemo` (line 183), `updateMemo` (202), `deleteMemo` (258), and `listMemos`/`getMemo`/`listMemoComments` (116, 146, 276). The client is typed against the generated `memo_service_pb.ts` schema in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/`.
